name: cottontail
description: Tiny Zig-based JavaScript runtime scaffold for Electrobun.
author: Blackboard Technologies Inc.

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.js && node scripts/setup-zig-html-rewriter.js && node scripts/setup-jsc.js
scripts.check-zig-version: bun run setup && node scripts/zig.js version
scripts.build: bun run setup && node scripts/zig.js build
scripts.test:release: node --test scripts/build-release-workflow.test.js scripts/release-benchmark.test.js scripts/release-binary-contract.test.js scripts/release-contract.test.js scripts/release-version.test.js scripts/verify-linux-glibc.test.js scripts/x64-baseline-release.test.js
scripts.compat:surface:all: bun run compat:surface && bun run compat:surface:view
scripts.compat:upstream: bun run build && node scripts/run-upstream-tests.js all
scripts.compat:upstream:bun:ci: node --test scripts/bun-compat-workflow.test.js scripts/bun-status-platform.test.js scripts/import-upstream-tests.test.js scripts/review-bun-test-changes.test.js tests/upstream-status-accounting.test.mjs tests/upstream-runner.test.mjs && node scripts/check-bun-status.js && node scripts/run-upstream-tests.js bun
scripts.compat:upstream:xfail: bun run build && node scripts/run-upstream-tests.js all --include-expected-failures
scripts.test:zig: bun run setup && node scripts/zig.js build test
scripts.test: bun run test:zig && bun run test:js
scripts.test:blocking: bun run test && bun run test:electrobun && bun run test:electrobun:cli
